question: What benefits are produced by using the lotus-shaped fire-pit in ritual?
premises: The lotus-named fire-pit has a causal function.
It is linked to all prosperity.
It is also described as giving nourishment.
inference: The lotus-shaped fire-pit is the cause of all prosperity and gives nourishment.
